about_the_game:
Support us on Kickstarter and our socials! Links on right ; )

Get ready to dive into GigCrawler, a multiplayer roguelike where corporate freelancers blast through bullet hell dungeons, chasing paychecks and dodging deadlines! Gear up, test your wildest builds, and uncover the secrets lurking in this chaotic universe.


Enter Dearth, a demonic land reshaped by human capitalism. Play as a freelance hunter hired by Ward Corp, a major corporation specializing in the security of Dearth's diverse population.

Your mission? Battle against the conservative demons and beasts of the old Era, for the sake of civilization... and your paycheck.

Gig Crawler seeks to be a demonic parody of the contemporary labor market and gig economy. Everyday issues and archetypes will appear in Dearth, but with a demonic, fantasy twist!

GigCrawler brings together gameplay styles that appeal to all kinds of players. At its heart, it’s a roguelike with constantly shifting dungeons that keep you fighting, gathering, and upgrading. As a multiplayer RPG, teamwork is crucial, but here’s the catch: you can swap roles anytime, keeping the game fun and unpredictable.


Soul Modding – Because Who Needs a Stable Identity?

Thanks to some totally safe tech from WardCorp, every Freelancer can swap abilities by jamming Mods into their Soul Modder. Roguelite randomness? Nah, you’re in charge now.

Each Mod is special, some are even one-of-a-kind. Dive into dungeons, experiment with builds, and climb the ranks. Your career, your choices, your soul (probably still intact). Take control of your destiny like a true Freelancer, because commitment is overrated!

Multiplayer & Indirect Competition – Because Misery Loves Company

GigCrawler is best played in co-op, because suffering together is way more fun. Sure, you can go solo, but why would you when you can have teammates to blame? Every Freelancer can build their own way, but some loadouts shine in different situations. Translation: teamwork makes the dream work (and prevents screaming).

We’re also cooking up a rank board to see who the ultimate Freelancer is, without turning this into some sweaty PvP arena. It’s all about flexing, not fighting.

Weapon System & Career Development - Climbing the Gig Ladder, One Dubious Weapon at a Time

Just like real life, your career starts with absolute randomness. Each run throws a chaotic mix of weapons your way - sometimes you're lucky, sometimes you’re stuck swinging a rusty spoon. But hey, that’s the freelancer grind!

Weapons come in all shapes and archetypes, with a deep system to discover. A sword is melee, sure, but melee is just the beginning. The more you progress, the more you tame the randomness, making it easier to find the right tools for the job. But remember, just like in real life, you’ve gotta earn that stability. Climb the ranks, master your craft, and maybe, just maybe, you’ll stop getting stuck with a stapler.


Affinity System / Networking – It’s Not What You Know, It’s Who You Know (And Who Screws You Over)

We'll announce the new characters on our Discord soon!

In the gig world, connections matter. Some NPCs will hook you up with exclusive weapons, items, or mysterious things (totally not stolen). Others? Well… let’s just say trusting the wrong person might lead to some unfortunate surprises, like bad encounters mid-run or losing something really important.

Follow the right quests, build your network, and climb the ranks. But choose wisely, because in true freelancer fashion, a handshake today might be a stab in the back tomorrow 😈

Shape Your Freelancer - Look However, Fight However

Thanks to the totally ethical magic of the Soul Modder, your appearance is your choice. Wanna be a tiny, adorable assassin lugging around a gatling gun? Do it. A medieval tank blessed by the holy light but wielding… a rocket launcher? Go off.

Your looks and abilities? Completely separate - like they should be in real life, coff coff. So shape-shift, mix it up, and create the Freelancer that truly represents you (or just the most cursed combination imaginable).

Biome-Coded Dungeons - Prep Hard, Pray Harder

Every GigCrawler run drops you into procedurally generated dungeons, new enemies, and loot that depends on what’s lurking in the shadows. Sounds fun, right?

But here’s the kicker: your build is locked in before you even step foot inside. No mid-run Soul Modder swaps, no take-backs. You either prepare like a pro or end up as biome fertilizer. Choose wisely, adapt on the go, and maybe, just maybe, you won’t be that Freelancer who brought a spoon to a mech fight.

content_descriptors.notes: Fantasy violence, Use of Magic Substances, Strong Language

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 +
  • Processor: I5 9th gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Rtx 2070 +
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: GigCrawler is a co-op roguelite where Freelancers swap abilities, prepare builds, and tackle procedurally generated, biome-coded dungeons. Adapt, grind, and survive the gig chaos!
